Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme's roadmap for search and customer support. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

• Recap: You’re evaluating an inference runtime to reduce latency for real-time suggestions and to cut per-token costs for high-volume queries.
• Key success criteria: sub-50ms response for most flows, predictable unit economics, and SOC2-aligned logging for audits.
• Next step: Technical deep dive + demo where Camila (SE) will walk through the runtime, routing, and batching examples tied to your traffic profile.

Would next Wednesday Feb 18 or Thursday Feb 19 work for a 45-min technical deep dive? Please share preferred times (PST) and who from your side will join so we can include the right demos. I’ll send a calendar invite + Zoom link once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa
